lead: Knives from Messermanufaktur Ulbrich come with a 2-year warranty when you care for them according to the enclosed care instructions. A care booklet and a care product are included free of charge.

items.x: Care instructions in a small booklet
A care product, free of charge
If your knife fails within 2 years although you have cared for it as instructed, we repair it or refund the purchase price.
Damage caused by improper handling – for example rust after putting the knife in a dishwasher – is not covered. Goodwill may be possible in individual cases, but not as a rule.
Email or call us, ideally with photos of the damage and a short description. We will then agree how the knife gets back to the workshop.
This warranty is a voluntary promise by the workshop. Your statutory rights remain unaffected.

faq.a: 2 years, provided the knife is cared for according to the enclosed care instructions.
No. Damage from a dishwasher counts as improper handling. Goodwill may be possible in individual cases, but not as a rule.
